title: Forget Innovation! Tim Cook's Greatest Contribution to Apple Is This $841 Billion Acquisition.
title_zh: 忘记创新！蒂姆·库克对苹果最大的贡献就是这次8410亿美元的收购。
summary: This investment directly boosted Apple's earnings per share, but has absolutely nothing to do with innovation.
summary_zh: 这项投资直接提升了苹果的每股收益，但与创新完全无关。

title: Stocks close lower on fading hopes for quick Iran deal
title_zh: 由于伊朗快速达成协议的希望减弱，股市收低
summary: STORY: Wall Street's main indexes closed lower on Thursday, with the Dow dipping more than a third of a percent, the S&P 500 shedding about four-tenths of a percent and the tech-heavy Nasdaq dropping roughly nine-tenths of a percent.Hopes dimmed for a quick end to the Middle E...
summary_zh: 故事：华尔街主要股指周四收低，其中道琼斯指数下跌逾三分之一，标准普尔 500 指数下跌约十分之四，而以科技股为主的纳斯达克指数下跌约十分之九。中东经济快速结束的希望越来越渺茫……

title: 4 Financial Pros Offer 5 Stocks, 3 ETFs to Play the Software Bust
title_zh: 4 名金融专业人士提供 5 只股票、3 只 ETF 来应对软件泡沫破灭
summary: Software stocks tumbled again after IBM and ServiceNow earnings. But cybersecurity and data stocks may be bargains.
summary_zh: IBM 和 ServiceNow 公布财报后，软件股再次暴跌。但网络安全和数据股票可能很便宜。

title: Why Microsoft is offering its first voluntary employee buyout
title_zh: 为什么微软要提供首次员工自愿买断
summary: Microsoft (MSFT) is planning its first-ever voluntary employee buyout for up to 7% of its US workforce. Yahoo Finance Tech Editor Dan Howley discusses the news in the video above.
summary_zh: 微软 (MSFT) 正计划对其美国最多 7% 的员工进行有史以来的首次自愿员工买断。雅虎财经技术编辑 Dan Howley 在上面的视频中讨论了这一消息。

title: Meta to cut 8,000 jobs, Microsoft offers buyouts to to staff as AI spending costs hit Big Tech workers
title_zh: Meta 将裁员 8,000 人，微软向员工提供买断，因为人工智能支出成本打击了大型科技员工
summary: Meta and Microsoft are the latest Big Tech giants to trim staff as AI costs continue to balloon.
summary_zh: 随着人工智能成本持续飙升，Meta 和微软是最新裁员的大型科技巨头。
